positions.name: RetroFormatAdoption
positions.frame: what format does the engineering team run its sprint retrospectives in, and how did it come to be that format?
positions.why: All three statements read in one direction: the team's retro practice. src-1 announces the adoption of the Velociraptor format, src-2 describes its structure (Sailed, Stalled, Capsized), and src-3 places it against the start-stop-continue format it replaced. They are coherent and carry no tension. src-1 reads as decision-grade while src-2 and src-3 are plain claims. The group is a team-process frame that no existing narrative leaf or stratum holds, since the only existing structure concerns the analytics database decision, so `under` is omitted.
